response.sql: WITH per_event AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent) AS average_spent, AVG(remaining) AS average_remaining FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event) SELECT link_to_event, average_spent, average_remaining, average_remaining - (SELECT AVG(average_remaining) FROM per_event) AS remaining_difference FROM per_event ORDER BY remaining_difference IS NULL, remaining_difference DESC LIMIT 10;
